Name: GetCategorySummary
SQL:
-- sgl.query(name: GetCategorySummary, command: many)
SELECT
  category,
  COUNT(*) AS total_count,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE region = 'north') AS north_count,
  SUM(amount) FILTER (WHERE region = 'south') AS south_total
FROM sales
GROUP BY category
ORDER BY category;
